title: TYP: ``poly1d`` shape-typing
body:
The array types of `np.poly1d` are now narrowed to have 1d shape-type, because suprisingly, `poly1d` is 1d. There's one exception though, and that's when 0d or >1d array-likes are passed as `val` to `np.poly1d.__call__`, in which case the shape is preserved. So this also adds overloads to `__call__` so that arrays with known shape-type return an exact shape-type, and bare scalar-likes, 1d- and 2d array-like sequences also return a rank-2 array. 

I've used `Incomplete` instead of `Any` for scalar-types (which `Incomplete`  simply aliases) because it's possible, and even feasible, to make those exact. Doing so would require turning `poly1d` into a generic type though, so that's out of scope here, and probably needs to be discussed a bit to see if we actually want to do that (seeing as `poly1d` is considered legacy-ish functionality). So I guess I'll put it on the agenda for tomorrow's community meeting.

---

Pair programmed with AI.
